verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no mention of NVLink, high-bandwidth multi-GPU interconnect, or rack-scale/datacenter deployment for the RTX 5080; all documentation focuses on single-GPU gaming/creator/AI-inference features (DLSS, CUDA toolkit, local AI PC use). This is a fair question for a GPU product line, but the evidence shows no datacenter-scale interconnect or multi-GPU system support.
